# Thunderbird Calendar read-dialog positioning and shared source loading

In `mail/components/calendar/content/dialog-position.mjs`, available side space equal to `dialog.width + 2 * margin` is valid placement: use inclusive `>=` for `hasSpaceStart`/`hasSpaceEnd`. Exact 100px-dialog/12px-margin tests place at `x: "12px"` (start) and `x: "136px"` (end); `./mach xpcshell-test comm/mail/components/calendar/test/unit/test_dialog_position.js` passed 91 checks. [Task 4]

Scope: calendar.
